# Pillar PEO Advisors

> Independent PEO advisory firm helping U.S. employers (5–500 employees) compare PEO options, understand tradeoffs, and make confident decisions — at no cost to the employer.

Pillar PEO Advisors guides business owners, HR leaders, and nonprofit teams through the process of selecting, switching, or evaluating a Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The site explains how PEOs work, who they fit, and how to avoid common pitfalls.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Pillar's advisory service and audiences served.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): The Pillar advisory process from discovery to decision.
- [Switch Your PEO](/switch-your-peo): Guidance for employers replacing a current PEO.
- [PEO for Nonprofits](/peo-for-nonprofits): How PEOs reduce admin drag for mission-driven teams.
- [Do We Need a PEO?](/do-we-need-a-peo): Help for first-time PEO buyers.
- [Resources](/resources): Educational guides on PEO selection, pricing, and switching.
- [About](/about): Background on Pillar and the leadership team (Caleb & Josiah Sherrill).
- [Contact](/contact): Schedule a strategy call or send a message.
- [HR Headache Score](/hr-headache-score): 15-question quiz that scores your HR pain points.

- [PEO for Nonprofits Guide](/resources/peo-for-nonprofits-guide): Nonprofit-specific considerations.
